outfit.name: 原宿落肩粗花针织衫与双层皮腿环
outfit.prose: An oversized chunky-knit beige wool cardigan sliding off one shoulder, layered over a ribbed black cropped tube top, a charcoal micro pleated skirt, and sheer black thighhighs. A signature dual-buckle leather thigh strap cinches the upper thigh with subtle soft indentation, finished with chunky retro sneakers.
